entries.description: Public, stateless, read-only MCP Streamable HTTP service exposing the DIO/ODI Reference Model, canonical SKOS vocabulary, and selected derived Agentic ER and Policy-as-Code reference mappings. It does not inspect integrating applications, validate evidence, authorize mutations, or execute production writes.

The canonical DIO/ODI SKOS Reference Vocabulary, providing stable concept URIs, preferred labels, definitions, scope notes, and semantic relations. This is a SKOS vocabulary and is not presented as a completed OWL ontology.

An append-only, source-linked event feed documenting evidenced changes across the DIO/ODI conceptual system and its public infrastructure, including vocabulary, mappings, provenance, publications, archives, distributions, and deployments. It distinguishes event dates, scope, impact, preserved invariants, evidence, and lineage; it is not a Git commit log or proof of intervention effectiveness.
